source_units.text: Clarify a disputed move in a fictional board game.
The intended readers are players who know the basic rules.
Keep the tone patient and impartial.
The full text must be between 55 and 85 words.
Include the following invented details: In Amber Gate, a player spends one lantern to inspect a bridge.
Inspection reveals its symbol but does not open it: the bridge remains closed.
A separate key action opens it.
Preserve these exact phrases: "Amber Gate", "one lantern", "the bridge remains closed".
